integrity: The proof is mathematical; finite checker tests are supplementary and do not independently certify the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Torus-fixed points only, over the complex numbers. Prior work already includes general Hibi smoothness criteria and global class groups; the claimed contribution is the explicit all-rooted-tree local rank census and enumerators. Unindexed equivalent derivations are a residual originality risk.
title: Cycle-space divisor classes and leaf-tail smooth-point counts for rooted-tree order varieties
